让肖像与您的音频同步说话或唱歌

在 Floyo 上打开这个可立即运行的工作流程。无需安装。

它是如何运作的

步骤 1. 上传您的肖像。清晰的正面图像，嘴部、下巴和下巴清晰可见。这成为视频中的角色。适用于：爆头、动漫角色、AI 生成的面孔、角色渲染

步骤 2. 上传您的音频。演讲、旁白或歌唱。该工作流程将人声与任何背景噪音分开，并缩短至 8 秒。

步骤 3. 写下提示。描述角色和表演，就像“动漫机甲飞行员说话专注、坚定、准确的口型同步、自然的眨眼”。描述表演，而不是镜头移动。

步骤 4. 点击运行并下载。当您的音频驱动嘴巴时，三遍会生成并升级剪辑。您将获得 24fps 的 10 秒 1080p MP4，其中嵌入了音频。准备就绪：首映·DaVinci Resolve·After Effects·YouTube·TikTok

第一次？上传正面肖像和音频剪辑，编辑提示来描述您的角色，然后保留其他所有内容。

概述

此工作流程使用 Lightricks 的开源视听模型 LTX Video 2.3 将肖像和音频剪辑转换为口型同步视频。它会读取您的音频，而不仅仅是提示。分离模型将人声从音轨中拉出，LTX 音频编码器将其转换为特征，模型生成与语音相匹配的嘴部运动、时间安排和下巴运动。静态相机 LoRA 锁定框架，使脸部始终保持居中。三通道管道以较小的基本尺寸构建剪辑，然后放大两次以达到 1080p，同时使用细节 LoRA 沿途锐化脸部。由于同步读取的是声音而不是单词，因此它可以跨语言运行。您上传肖像和音频，编写简短的提示，然后在大约 2 分 46 秒内返回一个 10 秒的 1080p 剪辑。无需设置，无需节点 金属丝。

适用对象：创作者、动画师和课程制作者，他们希望在 ComfyUI 中使用音频驱动的说话角色，而无需从头开始连接多通道口型同步管道。不适用于：快速的一键式剪辑。这是一个繁重的渲染，源肖像和干净的音频决定了大部分结果。

为什么选择弗洛约

Floyo 是浏览器中唯一为团队构建的 ComfyUI 平台。

  • 专为团队打造。在整个团队中共享运行历史记录、文件和模型。队友会打开您的确切路线并从您上次停下的地方继续。没有文件交接，没有版本混乱。

  • 无需安装，无需设置。每个工作流程和模型均已预加载。在浏览器中打开它并运行。无需下载，无需配置。

  • 没有本地硬件。工作流程在 H100 NVL GPU 上运行，因此重型模型无需您自己的卡即可快速运行。您的 VRAM 不再是限制。

  • 在一处打开和关闭模型。Floyo 同时运行开源工作流程和 API 模型。

如何使用（在 Floyo 上的浏览器中）

  1. 上传您的正面肖像和音频剪辑。

  2. 写一个简短的提示来描述角色和表演，然后运行。

  3. 下载 1080p 口型同步剪辑，适合任何编辑器。

期望模型已预加载，因此无需下载任何内容。运行它需要一个免费的 Floyo 帐户。这个比大多数剪辑都要重：每个剪辑大约需要 2 分 46 秒，因为它需要通过三遍来生成和升级。有几件事决定结果。嘴部可见的正面人像同步效果最佳，侧面或极端角度则不然。干净、独立的人声比埋藏在音乐或混响下的音频提供更紧密的同步。不要在提示中出现与相机移动相关的词语，因为它们会影响静态相机锁定。关于许可：LTX Video 2.3 是 Lightricks 开源的，但 LoRA 和支持模型有自己的条款，因此在商业使用之前请检查每个组件的许可。

使用案例

头部说话视频。将画外音和肖像变成 1080p 说话的角色，并具有口型同步、自然眨眼和微妙的头部运动。

歌唱与音乐。输入音轨和角色图像以生成具有匹配嘴巴运动的歌唱表演。

课程和讲解内容。通过讲座和讲解员的一张肖像生成一致的讲师，无需拍摄。

角色动画。为短片、预告片和概念验证卷轴提供插图或 AI 角色对话驱动的口型同步。

LTX 2.3 唇形同步可以带来什么？

o.en:
Make a portrait speak or sing in sync with your audio

Open this ready-to-run workflow on Floyo. No install needed.

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1. Upload your portrait. A clear, front-facing image with the mouth, jaw, and chin visible. This becomes the character in the video. Works great with: headshots · anime characters · AI-generated faces · character renders

Step 2. Upload your audio. Speech, narration, or singing. The workflow separates the vocals from any background noise on its own and trims to 8 seconds.

Step 3. Write your prompt. Describe the character and the performance, like "anime mecha pilot speaking with focused determination, accurate lip sync, natural blinking." Describe the performance, not camera moves.

Step 4. Hit run and download. Three passes generate and upscale the clip while your audio drives the mouth. You get back a 10-second 1080p MP4 at 24fps with the audio embedded. Ready for: Premiere · DaVinci Resolve · After Effects · YouTube · TikTok

First time? Upload a front-facing portrait and an audio clip, edit the prompt to describe your character, and leave everything else as-is.

Overview

This workflow turns a portrait and an audio clip into a lip-synced video using LTX Video 2.3, an open-source audio-visual model from Lightricks. It reads your audio, not just a prompt. A separation model pulls the vocals out of the track, the LTX audio encoder turns them into features, and the model generates mouth movement, timing, and jaw motion that match the speech. A static camera LoRA locks the frame so the face stays centered the whole time. A three-pass pipeline builds the clip at a small base size, then upscales twice to reach 1080p, with detail LoRAs sharpening the face along the way. Because the sync reads sound, not words, it works across languages. You upload a portrait and audio, write a short prompt, and get back a 10-second 1080p clip in about 2 minutes 46 seconds. No setup, no nodes to wire.

Who it's for: creators, animators, and course makers who want audio-driven talking characters in ComfyUI without wiring a multi-pass lip-sync pipeline from scratch. Not for: a fast one-click clip. This is a heavy render, and the source portrait and clean audio decide most of the result.

Why Floyo

Floyo is the only ComfyUI platform built for teams in the browser.

  • Made for teams.Share run history, files, and models across your whole team. A teammate opens your exact run and picks up where you left off. No file handoffs, no version confusion.

  • No install, no setup.Every workflow and model is preloaded. Open it in your browser and run. Nothing to download, nothing to configure.

  • No local hardware.Workflows run on H100 NVL GPUs, so heavy models run fast without a card of your own. Your VRAM stops being the limit.

  • Open and closed models in one place.Floyo runs open-source workflows and API models side by side.

How to use (in your browser on Floyo)

  1. Upload your front-facing portrait and an audio clip.

  2. Write a short prompt describing the character and performance, then run.

  3. Download the 1080p lip-synced clip, ready for any editor.

ExpectationsThe models are preloaded, so there is nothing to download. Running it needs a free Floyo account. This one is heavier than most: each clip takes about 2 minutes 46 seconds, because it generates and upscales across three passes. A few things decide the outcome. Front-facing portraits with a visible mouth sync best, profile or extreme angles do not. Clean, isolated vocals give tighter sync than audio buried under music or reverb. Keep camera-movement words out of the prompt, since they fight the static camera lock. On licensing: LTX Video 2.3 is open-source from Lightricks, but the LoRAs and supporting models carry their own terms, so check each component's license before commercial use.

Use Cases

Talking-Head Videos. Turn a voiceover and a portrait into a 1080p talking character with lip-sync, natural blinking, and subtle head movement.

Singing & Music. Feed a vocal track and a character image to generate a singing performance with matched mouth movement.

Course & Explainer Content. Generate a consistent instructor from one portrait across lectures and explainers, no filming.

Character Animation. Give illustrated or AI characters dialogue-driven lip-sync for shorts, trailers, and proof-of-concept reels.
